page.layout: One page of text in a single column, a Hebrew-Latin dictionary of entries under the letter ק. Running head "ק" at the top centre; printed page number "951" at the top left; gathering signature "Ooo 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: קַיָּם Stabilis. הִתְקַיֵּם Perstare, Subsistere, Stabiliri, Confirmari. קַיְמָא לָן Probatio nobis est.

מָקוֹם Locus, Deus, quia Illocalis & tamen ubique locorum praesens: Item, quòd omnis locus est plenus gloriâ ejus, scribit Ab. Esra, in princ. Esther. לְנֶגֶד הַמָּקוֹם יִרְבֶּה דְבָרִים Contra Deum multiplicat verba, Job.34.37. in Aben Esra, מְקוֹמִי Localis.
קוּץ Tadere, Naufeare. מוּקָצָה Naufea, Tadium.
הָקִיר · קוּר Manare, Scaturire. מָקוּר Scaturigo: Infinitivus modus, quasi variarum significationum per Tempora & personas fons & scaturigo: Item Metallum vel Minerale.
קְטִיגוֹר Accusator, κατήγορος. קְטִיגוֹרְיָא κατηγορία, Accusatio, R.Sal. Hof.14.2. Vide eundem Gen.18.33.
הִתְקוֹטֵט · קַטָּט Rixari, Contendere, Rixis irritare. קַטָּטָה Contentio, Rixa, Prov.10.13. in Kafvenaki.

קָטָן Minor, Minorennis: קְטַנָּה Minorennis puella. קְטַנּוּת Parvitas, Minorennitas. קְטָנִית Legumen. קְטָנִיּוֹת Legumina. קְטַנֵּי אֱמוּנָה Parvi fide, vacillantes, errantes in vera fide, Psal.106.7. in R.Sal.
קָטַע Incidere, Succidere: שָׁנָה מְקוּטָּע Annus intercisus.
קָטַר Ligare, Constringere, R.Dav. Amos 5.8. קוֹטֶר Diameter: מַחֲצִית קוֹטֶר Semidiameter: קִיטוֹר Exhalatio, fumus, vapor calidus & ficcus.
קַלַּח Effundi, Emanare. קִלּוּחַ Emanatio, Eruptio, Effluxus: מִקְלַחַת Fistula, ut fontis, unde aqua emanat.
קָלַט Colligere se, Recipere, Receptum detinere, Retinere. קְלִיטָה Receptio, Jos.7.19. in Kimchi. מִקְלָט Receptus, Refugii locus.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew headwords are read from a small, slightly blurred scan and may differ from the printer's exact pointing; the Hebrew forms were not checked against a standard lexicon. The left margin has ink marks and scan damage but no printed notes. Greek words were copied as read: κατήγορος, κατηγορία. Printed abbreviations such as "R.Sal." and "R.Dav." are kept as printed.
